title: The review-record tool takes a Fix check line on a PR opened after its review
why: `merge --review-record` refuses a Fix check line on a PR with no earlier record, so a PR opened after its review cannot record its fix checks. #1781 lists them in a note instead. Found by lane sha-hex-followups (coordinator, 23:05 CST Nov 7).
note: Done check: a red test where a PR opened after its review posts a record with a Fix check line, and a Fix check line with no review at all is still refused. Related: step record-before-fix-push. Slug and title by triage; no source gave one. Queue fix under the item 384 hold.
